core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghadeer corresponds to the Arabic form غدير (Arabic root غ د ر (gh-d-r); غدير (Ghadīr)). Its core sense is small stream, brook. Ghadeer (غدير) is Arabic for 'a small stream, brook, pool of running water' — used as a feminine given name. It is historically resonant because of Ghadir Khumm, the site of the Event of Ghadir. The source gloss 'river, flow' is a fair rendering of the 'small stream' sense.
